## Problem

What real repository state cannot repo-truth represent correctly today?

## Minimal example

Show the smallest Issue / PR / document / relation set that demonstrates the problem.

## Proposed rule

State the deterministic rule without relying on an LLM judgment.

## Authority

Why is this evidence strong enough to change repository truth or eligibility?

## Failure mode

What could this rule classify incorrectly?

## Falsifier

Give at least one case where the proposed rule **must not** fire.

## Compatibility

Does this change any existing truth, dependency, or eligibility invariant?
